models_hint: These providers are the ones the agent calls. Claude Code uses your Claude subscription.
about_license: A custom product name is allowed for deployments of at most 50 users in any 30-day period. Larger deployments keep the Mokli name unless an enterprise license says otherwise.
telegram_step_create: Create a bot and copy its token.
telegram_step_paste: Paste the token here and save.
whatsapp_scan: Scan this code from WhatsApp on your phone: Linked devices, then Link a device.
restart_required: The gateway needs a restart before this channel runs.
chart_missing: The chart library is not available on this server.
job_protected: This system job cannot be removed
claude_connect_help: Open Claude in this browser to link your subscription. Mokli stores CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN the same way as a pasted setup-token.
claude_token_help: Or paste CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from `claude setup-token` if you already generated one. The official Claude CLI reads this environment variable on the next call.
claude_code_help: Finish sign-in on the Claude page. It shows a code (often code#state). Paste that here. Anthropic does not redirect back to this site.
claude_token_required: Paste a non-empty Claude Code token.
oauth_help: Sign in from this device. No API key is stored in config.
oauth_callback_help: After you allow access, the browser opens a localhost address and shows a connection error. That error is expected. Copy the entire address from the browser bar and paste it below.
oauth_callback_paste: Full address from the browser bar
oauth_code_help: After you allow access, paste the authorization code here.
oauth_device_help: Open the sign-in page and enter this code. Nothing has to come back to this phone, and localhost is not used.
oauth_device_waiting: Waiting for the code to be entered
provider_fields_required: Name and API base are required
model_pick_help: Choose one model, or several from this provider. The primary model is called first. The others are fallbacks. Each card shows modalities, price per million tokens, context, and release date when the provider publishes them.
model_configure_first: Save this provider first, then choose its models.
model_cleared: Models from this provider were cleared
model_search_more: Showing part of {count}. Search to narrow the list.
mt5_form_hint: Type the broker name. Mokli lists the companies available in MT5, then that company's servers.
mt5_address_hint: Type the server address, such as company.com:443
mt5_login_title: Log in to an existing account
mt5_incomplete: Enter the account number, password, and server.
mt5_password_note: The password is saved only after the connection succeeds.
